ratchet_policy: Bumped 2026-08-11 to 150 clusters / 8500 duplicate LOC (owner-authorized, #2057) to absorb the ADR-053 Learning Center. The package is a new subsystem: the scanned function count went from 1522 to 2361, and the two absolute ratchets were set against the smaller codebase. The duplicate PERCENTAGE went DOWN — 11.38% against a 13.17% baseline and a 13.83% ratchet — and max_cluster_size is unchanged at 8, so the code added is less duplicative than what was already here; only the absolute counts moved. The seven clusters the new package contributes were inventoried before the bump rather than assumed: two are `TutorialDriver`'s Protocol method stubs paired with `ManifestDriver`'s implementations (an interface beside what implements it, which the embedding cannot tell from a copy); one is the tutorial's own teaching material, `assets/code/normalize_fluorescence.py` and its `_renamed` twin, whose whole lesson is that they differ by one `type_name` line; three are small genuine similarities inside the package (`_eval_node_exists`/`_eval_edge_exists`, `execute_action`/`execute_replay`, `StartSessionRequest.key`/`tutorial_key_of`, 10-22 LOC each); and the seventh, `_eval_run_succeeded`/`_eval_run_failed`, was consolidated onto one `_runs_for` walk before this bump was requested. Follow-ups: consolidate the three remaining in-package pairs and ratchet down (#1578 already tracks the tools_plot outcome dataclasses and provider envelope boilerplate); and decide whether `src/scistudio/tutorials/core/**/assets/**` belongs in the scanned root at all, since it is authored teaching content rather than product code.
